trailhead.label: The Kreuzbrünnl car park on the Nörderberg above Naturns, the board’s start

cautions: Cattle graze around the three alms in summer: keep your dog on a short lead and give cows a wide berth.
Forest roads shared with farm vehicles and the hiker taxi: lead on.
The farm road up to Kreuzbrünnl is narrow and steep: drive slowly or take the hiker taxi.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
